Having lived with Nana in Japan for nearly 10 years, I've noticed many cultural differences.

Japan is especially famous for its frugality,

but is that really true? Haha.

This video, sponsored by the Korea Energy Agency, explores cultural differences and similarities between Korea and Japan regarding energy conservation during the summer, based on our own experiences!

✅ The ideal indoor temperature in summer is 26 degrees Celsius!
✅ Unplug unused plugs
✅ Use high-efficiency lighting and turn off unused lights!

Let's practice energy-saving habits this summer that protect not only the planet but also our homes! 😄

#KoreaEnergyAgency #KEA #EnergySaving #Summer #ElectricitySaving #WaterSaving #NanaSonaYoon

It was a day where I experienced the many differences in Japanese education and lifestyle when it comes to energy conservation.
